text:
Reviewing the contract against the existing rule inventory, five clauses or implied invariants appear to have no enforcing rule.

```json
[
  {
    "id": "GEN-001",
    "dimension": "temporal correctness",
    "severity": "Medium",
    "scope": "order",
    "title": "PromisedDate must not precede CreatedDate",
    "contract": "PromisedDate is the promised delivery date - a commitment made at or after the order is created.",
    "rationale": "TMP-005 checks DeliveredDate against CreatedDate but nothing checks PromisedDate. A promise dated before the order exists makes every on-time-delivery metric meaningless, and it is the kind of value a backfill or a timezone bug produces.",
    "check": {
      "type": "timestampOrder",
      "earlier": "order.createdDate",
      "later": "order.promisedDate"
    }
  },
  {
    "id": "GEN-002",
    "dimension": "data quality",
    "severity": "Low",
    "scope": "pair",
    "title": "Every event must record the actor that performed it",
    "contract": "ResourceUser is the actor or system that performed the activity.",
    "rationale": "No existing rule touches ResourceUser. Process mining attributes work to resources; a blank actor silently collapses into an 'unknown' bucket and distorts any handover or workload analysis.",
    "check": {
      "type": "fieldPresent",
      "field": "event.resourceUser"
    }
  },
  {
    "id": "GEN-003",
    "dimension": "value correctness",
    "severity": "High",
    "scope": "pair",
    "title": "CustomerName must be identical on both sides",
    "contract": "CustomerName refers to the same entity on both sides.",
    "rationale": "The denormalised customer name should survive the sync unchanged, otherwise customer-level aggregation splits one customer into several.",
    "check": {
      "type": "fieldsEqual",
      "left": "order.customerName",
      "right": "event.customerName",
      "normalise": []
    }
  },
  {
    "id": "GEN-004",
    "dimension": "data quality",
    "severity": "Medium",
    "scope": "order",
    "title": "Discount code must be present on discounted orders",
    "contract": "Orders carrying a reduced amount should reference the discount that produced it.",
    "rationale": "Without the code, a reduced amount cannot be reconciled against the pricing engine.",
    "check": {
      "type": "fieldPresent",
      "field": "order.discountCode"
    }
  },
  {
    "id": "GEN-005",
    "dimension": "referential integrity",
    "severity": "Low",
    "scope": "order",
    "title": "CustomerId must match the documented CUST-## format",
    "contract": "CustomerId string CUST-##",
    "rationale": "REF-002 asserts the OrderId format but nothing asserts CustomerId. A malformed customer key breaks any join to a customer master.",
    "check": {
      "type": "matchesPattern",
      "field": "order.customerId",
      "pattern": "^CUST-\\d{2}$"
    }
  }
]
```
